newsitem.title: JAPAN: New Japan Chemical bid-only after oil spill.
newsitem.headline: New Japan Chemical bid-only after oil spill.

text.p: New Japan Chemical Co Ltd shares were bid-only in early Thursday morning trade, inspired by hopes that the firm would benefit from Japan's worst-ever oil spill, brokers said.
As of 0042 GMT, the shares were bid-only at 338 yen after closing at 328 the previous day on the Osaka bourse.

"The firms is involved in making substances which separate oil from water and also substances which prevent the two from mixing, and there is speculation that the firm may profit from the accident," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
